setup: node "$EVALS_DIR/replace.mjs" src/app.module.ts '        whitelist: true,\n        forbidNonWhitelisted: true,\n' ''
query: Can you review my uncommitted changes before I commit?
expected_behavior: Runs hunk session list --json and, with no matching session, asks the user to launch hunk diff and waits instead of reviewing in chat
Does not run interactive hunk diff or hunk show itself

If a session is available: posts findings that dropping whitelist/forbidNonWhitelisted plus spreading the body lets PATCH overwrite id and arbitrary fields, and that updated titles are no longer trimmed
